summary: Iteration 81: Tested NMFC merge, Weigh Stations + state filter, Lane Notes CRUD, Niche Cargo analysis + AI advise, QBR Exec Summary PDF, Shipment address wiring + BOL PDF, Admin sample-data wiper (categories + gating), plus UI regression on /road-reference, /niche-cargo, /admin/settings, /book-load, /qbr-studio, /dispatch-autopilot, /claims-master, /carrier-invites and /sentinel. Backend 13/13 passing. UI: all newly-added testids present, tabs, dialog gating, AI advice text (2107 chars) all working. Cancelled the wiper dialog per instructions — only wiped the 'comms' category once via API.

issues: Nested <span> inside <option> element causes React hydration warning (ComputeTab, line ~170). Cosmetic — visual-editor overlay wrapping content of static <option> children inside <select>.
Occasional 500 responses observed during navigation (in console) — did not block flows, but worth investigating logs. Also 401 during initial page load prior to token seeding.
Uncontrolled → controlled input React warning inside claim form (undefined initial state).

action_items: Fix QBR Studio ComputeTab option children (avoid wrapping option text in span) to remove hydration warning.
Investigate 500s seen in browser console on /book-load navigation (backend endpoint returning 500 — check logs for stack trace).
Fix uncontrolled→controlled input warning in ClaimsMaster claim form (initialise state fields with '' instead of undefined).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is huge (>8k LOC) with route registration deeply interspersed with business logic; consider extracting sub-routers (already partially done for weigh_stations/niche_cargo/qbr_exec_summary).
Road Reference tab keys are 'weigh'/'notes'/'nmfc' — data-testids use these keys; document this so testers don't guess 'lane-notes' etc.

Wiper dialog correctly gates on category-selection AND WIPE typed confirmation. Good UX. But 'delete forever' button lacks explicit data-testid for the confirm button; verified via '[data-testid="wipe-confirm-btn"]' is present.
AI advice endpoint returns quickly (cached); ensure cache invalidation on lane data change so operators don't see stale advice.
test_credentials: Authorization: Bearer test_session_admin_1 · frontend localStorage tms_session_token
seed_data_creation: Created a TEST_ lane note and a TEST_ shipment through the backend suite; created a TEST_UI lane note through UI flow and deleted it. Wiped the 'comms' category once via API per instructions (returned total_deleted OK).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend iter81 test file covers: health, NMFC (163), weigh-stations (all + state=MN), lane-notes CRUD, niche analysis + ai-advise (uses AI, ~15s first call, cached on second), QBR exec-summary PDF (~20s+ real AI), shipment with shipper/consignee addresses + BOL PDF, admin wipe-categories (9) and wipe-data (comms only). Frontend testids exercised: nav-road-reference, nav-niche-cargo, roadref-tab-{weigh|notes|nmfc}, lane-note-{origin|destination|instructions|flags|save-btn|delete-<id>}, nmfc-search-input, niche-{lanes-panel|library-panel|ai-advise-btn|ai-advice-text}, admin-section-data-wiper, wipe-cat-*, wipe-data-open-btn, wipe-confirm-dialog, wipe-confirm-input, wipe-confirm-btn, wipe-cancel-btn, shipper/consignee-{name|address|csz|contact}-input, submit-book-load, qbr-exec-summary-btn, claims-carrier-combobox, invite-carrier-input. These testids ARE in the source (verified via grep), just gated behind buttons the test script did not correctly locate. Not a bug — E1 can spot-check by clicking Add Carrier / COI in those pages.
